name: UNLOOK – AI Chatbot & Lead Capture
author: unlook24

sections.description:
When a visitor lands on your site at 9 pm and has one question, most chat boxes say “leave a message”. UNLOOK answers.

UNLOOK is an AI chat assistant for small business websites. It answers visitors’ questions from the business info you give it (your services, prices, hours and the areas you cover), takes their name and phone number or email, shares your booking link (or, on Chat Plus, books a time right in the chat), and emails you every lead. It answers in your business’s name, and a small line under the chat says it is AI and “Powered by UNLOOK”.

What you get

  • Answers from your own information, day or night. If it doesn’t know something, it says so and asks you, instead of guessing.
  • Every lead emailed to you with the visitor’s name, phone number or email, and what they asked.
  • Every chat saved in your UNLOOK dashboard, word for word, so you can see exactly what was said.
  • Bookings: on Chat it shares your booking link; on Chat Plus it offers the times you are free and books one in the chat, checked against your Google Calendar if you connect it.
  • No code to paste: install, press Connect, and approve your site in UNLOOK.

Who it is for

Plumbers, heating and air companies, electricians, roofers, salons, clinics, shops, and any other small business with a website and a phone that doesn’t always get answered.

Set up in three steps

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → UNLOOK and press Connect UNLOOK.
  3. Log in to UNLOOK, check it’s your site, and press Connect this site. You come straight back to WordPress, and the chat is on every page.

Your account and cost

The plugin needs an UNLOOK account: UNLOOK is a paid service, with plans from $29 a month and no contract, so you can cancel any time. You can see a demo built from your own website first at https://unlook.in. Your answers, leads, chats and how the chat looks are all managed in your UNLOOK dashboard at app.unlook.in.

Phone calls too

UNLOOK can also answer the phone calls you miss, in your business’s name. That is a separate plan, set up in your UNLOOK account. This plugin adds the website chat.

Your site stays yours

The plugin keeps a single setting: your business’s UNLOOK id (the same public id the chat carries on every page). It stores no passwords or keys, and UNLOOK cannot change your WordPress settings, content or users: the only way the setting is ever written is your own click on Connect in wp-admin. Disconnect (Settings → UNLOOK) removes the chat from your site straight away.

External services

This plugin connects your site to UNLOOK, the service it exists for. UNLOOK is run by UNLOOK (https://unlook.in).

  • When you press Connect UNLOOK (Settings → UNLOOK), your browser goes to https://app.unlook.in/connect/wordpress with your site’s address (its home URL), the address of this settings page, and a one-time check value. Nothing is sent before you press Connect.
  • When you come back from UNLOOK, your site sends the one-time code UNLOOK gave you, and your site’s address, to https://app.unlook.in/api/connect/wordpress/exchange. UNLOOK answers with your business’s UNLOOK id, which the plugin stores.
  • Once connected, on every page of your site, visitors’ browsers load the chat from https://app.unlook.in (the loader script /loader/v1.js and the chat itself). When a visitor chats, their messages, and any name, phone number or email they choose to type, are sent to UNLOOK so it can answer them and pass the lead to you. The chat keeps a random chat id in the visitor’s browser (local storage) so a conversation carries on after a reload, and remembers for the browser session that the greeting was shown.
  • If you pick a Google font for the chat in your UNLOOK dashboard, visitors’ browsers also load that font from Google Fonts (https://fonts.googleapis.com). Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • While you are connecting, UNLOOK’s server asks your site one question, to confirm that your site itself asked to connect: a request to your site’s address with a check value (?unlook_check=…). Your site answers with a second check value and nothing else. It answers only during a connect you started (for up to 30 minutes).

UNLOOK Terms of Service: https://unlook.in/terms/
UNLOOK Privacy Policy: https://unlook.in/privacy/

Credits

The settings page uses the Bricolage Grotesque font (Copyright 2022 The Bricolage Grotesque Project Authors), under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The font and its licence (assets/OFL.txt) are bundled with the plugin; nothing is loaded from a font service.
sections.installation:
1. In wp-admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for “UNLOOK”, then Install and Activate. (Or upload the unlook folder to /wp-content/plugins/.)
  2. Go to Settings → UNLOOK and press Connect UNLOOK.
  3. Log in to UNLOOK and approve your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need an UNLOOK account?

Yes. The plugin connects your site to your UNLOOK account; it doesn’t work on its own. UNLOOK is a paid service with plans from $29 a month, and you can cancel any time. Start at https://unlook.in.

Does the chat say it is an AI?

Yes. Under every chat it shows “AI answers can be wrong · Powered by UNLOOK” (on sites in other languages, “Powered by UNLOOK”). It answers in your business’s name and uses your own name, colour and font.

What if it doesn’t know the answer?

It says so, takes the visitor’s details, and the question appears in your UNLOOK dashboard so you can add the answer once. Next time it knows.

Does it answer phone calls?

UNLOOK has phone answering as a separate plan, set up in your UNLOOK account. This plugin only adds the website chat.

Does it work on WordPress.com?

Only on WordPress.com plans that let you install plugins. Plans that don’t allow plugins don’t allow the chat’s code either.

Will it slow my site down?

The plugin adds one small script that loads after your page (deferred); it then fetches the chat from UNLOOK’s servers in the background, so your page shows first.

Does it work with my theme or page builder?

It adds one small script to your site’s footer, so it works with themes and page builders that load the standard WordPress footer.

Where does the chat data go?

To UNLOOK, so it can answer visitors and pass the lead to you. See “External services” above for exactly what is sent and when.

How do I remove the chat?

Settings → UNLOOK → Disconnect, or deactivate the plugin. Deleting the plugin also deletes its setting.

Where do I change what the chat says?

In your UNLOOK dashboard (app.unlook.in): Receptionist for its answers and messages (like the welcome message), Settings for how the chat looks.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Clearer plugin name and description. No change to how the plugin works.

1.2.0

  • Removed the “connect from the UNLOOK dashboard” route and everything behind it: no Application Passwords, no REST API setting, no scheduled clean-up. The plugin now changes nothing on your site except when you press Connect or Disconnect yourself in wp-admin.

1.1.2

  • Security: when you come back from UNLOOK, your site now checks its own security token first, before it reads anything else, and only on Settings → UNLOOK.
  • The message shown after you connect or disconnect now appears only when your own site sent you to it.

1.1.1

  • The access you approve when connecting from the UNLOOK dashboard is now also removed by your own site, automatically, so there is never anything for you to tidy up.

1.1.0

  • Connect from your UNLOOK dashboard in one click: approve UNLOOK on your own WordPress and the chat is on. The plugin’s one setting (your business’s UNLOOK id) is now available to administrators through WordPress’s REST API, which is how UNLOOK fills it in.

1.0.1

  • Your site now confirms to UNLOOK that it was the one asking to connect, so nobody else can link your site’s address to their UNLOOK account.
  • The settings page in UNLOOK’s own style.

1.0.0

  • First release: connect in one click from Settings → UNLOOK, the chat on every page, disconnect any time.
